import datetime,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('audits/sensory_task_adapter_v1')
mode=sys.argv[1]
receipt=folder/f'{mode}_execution.json';log=folder/f'{mode}_execution.log'
assert not receipt.exists() and not log.exists()
commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd='/tmp/attcon-review-milestones-vvjs166i',text=True).strip()
started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
with log.open('w') as stream:
 result=subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/python','scripts/sensory_task_adapter_v1.py','--stage',mode],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
value={'stage':mode,'saved_tip_before_execution':commit,'started_utc':started,'finished_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'exit_code':result.returncode,'status':'terminal_success' if result.returncode==0 else 'terminal_failure','log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'execution_wrapper_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'original_artifacts_preserved':True,'goal_achieved':False}
receipt.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n')
print(log.read_text());raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
